name: Tesla Roadster Rocket
default_paint: Metallic grey, black aero and all-black glazing
geometry_reference: Seven user-supplied photographs; black glazing follows the user's colour instruction.
geometry_revision: Stock-relative scale in showroom and racing, smaller wheels, and circular triangulated wheel arches in all detail levels.
doors: Closed in every game model; open-door photographs supply body and panel reference only.

reference_images.view: Front, recessed fascia and trapezoid hood
Rocket demonstration, profile and aero disc wheels
Front three-quarter, grey facets and continuous canopy
Rear three-quarter, light recess and four-nozzle diffuser
Elevated front, curved nose and hood taper; doors are reference-only
Elevated rear, narrow glass, broad haunches, spoiler and bumper layers
Demonstration profile, door cutlines and dark aero wheels

simulation: Single-speed EV with a launch torque pulse; no separate flight/thruster controls.

capabilities.fand: Automatic fan adhesion to contacted driving surfaces in updated Restunts; one-byte enable flag, with optional adhs settings.

geometry_dimensions: Calibrated against stock Corvette/NSX using reported 2026 width and wheelbase; length and height remain photo-based estimates. See TERR-sizing.md.

sizing.quantization: 25% smaller wheel target is rounded to whole game units; identical six-unit radii are used in both racing LODs and at 20x in the showroom.

showroom.reference: Same calibrated car as racing, at the stock 20x display scale.

dashboard_revision: Larger photo-based rotating wheel with padded silver-edged grips, rollers, switches and paddles; contoured suede dashboard with masked steering-column recess, vents and carbon trim; live seven-segment speed and motor gauge on the rectangular centre screen. A native steering dot slides along a horizontal strip above the shaped wheel, as on the Pontiac Firebird. A thin charcoal roof header and rounded upper side corners follow the supplied Roadster interior photographs, with dashboard-matched shading and no window pillars across the forward view.
